item.title: Exploring the potential of aerial LiDAR: introduction to lidR
item.description:
1. Introduction and Acknowledgments

The biotope diversity team is exploring the opportunities and challenges presented by ALS (Airborne Laser Scanning) point cloud data and its associated models so that we are prepared for the new research questions that will undoubtedly arise once the new aerial LiDAR campaign (which is currently being carried out) is complete. The data and products are planned to be ready in 2028 as announced in this news item.
